summary: Build practical crypto AML skills in blockchain tracing, VASP risk, and Travel Rule controls. Review the five-day course and curriculum.
lede: Crypto AML training helps compliance officers, investigators, risk managers, and VASP teams assess digital-asset exposure. Through structured exercises, they practise blockchain transaction tracing, crypto customer due diligence, and alert triage, then document findings for escalation. The course also covers Travel Rule information handling and risk assessment for VASPs and DeFi activity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, investigate, monitor, or oversee money-laundering and terrorist-financing risks involving digital assets, crypto transactions, DeFi protocols, and VASPs.
modules: Crypto AML Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working knowledge of AML/CTF, customer due diligence, or transaction monitoring is expected. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with digital assets is useful but not essential.
